text:
Swap one hotel breakfast for this.
Osaka's chefs buy their fish here, one stop from the centre 👇

🏮 Kizu Market
More than 300 years old.
Visitors can walk in and buy too.

🚇 Daikokucho Station, Exit 1.
About 3 minutes on foot.

⏰ Go between 8:30 and 10:30.
Many stalls close by late morning.
Closed Sundays, holidays and some Wednesdays.

🍣 Then sit down to a seafood bowl.

👉 Two more local markets and the best times:
https://japanbystation.com/osaka-local-markets

Would you give up one hotel breakfast for this? 👇
